platform: GitHub Actions ubuntu-24.04, Node.js 22 and Python 3; portable checks only
acceptance_basis: The owner requested v0.1.1 publication and a marketplace review-thread update after being informed that live Omarchy verification remained outstanding. This records passing portable checks and pending live acceptance separately; it does not reuse the v0.1.0 XPS pass for changed runtime code.

results: 105 Node tests and five Python tests passed, with zero failures or skips.
Dictation transport tests run real router, control-helper and watcher subprocesses against a Unix socket fixture and inspect their live /proc command lines and environments.

Regression coverage includes both dictation backends, Unicode, bounds, protocol delimiters, unavailable/stale sockets, unsafe runtime permissions, partial/oversized replies, timeout, display selection and filter/wtype fallbacks.
Grok adapter tests preserve prompt stdin and reject an unsupported prompt-file flag without an argv retry.
Saved-bot restoration is exercised against the production selection functions under settings/roster load ordering.

Three source-packaging tests verify source/asset identity and checksums, explicit pending-live acknowledgement, failed evidence rejection, dirty-tree rejection and refusal of runtime changes after the evidence commit.

commands: Portable Omarchy release preflight with the trusted plugin validator: no errors; capability review warnings retained
results: The release includes PR #14 (saved bot), #15 (Grok prompt stdin) and #19 (private dictation transport).
The source-bound CI passed after the version, release workflow and packaging changes; the evidence record and final release-note count are subsequent documentation-only changes.
No settings or stored-state schema migration is introduced. Existing roster/settings preservation remains covered by portable regressions.
limitations: Native Quickshell, Superwhisper and Voxtype have not been exercised live for v0.1.1.
Fresh install, update from v0.1.0 and removal on an Omarchy host remain unverified for this patch.
The earlier XPS acceptance in docs/ACCEPTANCE.json belongs to v0.1.0; existing preview media belongs to the 27 October build.
Restart the shell after updating to load ShellIpc registration. Restarting clears session conversations and drafts.
Wake-phrase routing requires Omarchy's ShellIpc/socket contract introduced in September 2026; it fails without an argv fallback when unavailable. Local Grok requires --prompt-file support.
Portable tests and deterministic scans are not security audits or marketplace approval.
